milestone: 1: userspace programs inside QEMU VM under hermit
question: Do ordinary userspace programs run to completion inside a QEMU Linux VM that is itself a userspace process under Hermit, and is their output deterministic across independent Hermit runs?
qemu_args: -nodefaults -nic none -m 256M -accel tcg,thread=single -smp 1 -icount shift=0,sleep=off -rtc base=utc,clock=vm -kernel <bzImage> -initrd userspace-initramfs.cpio.gz -display none -serial stdio -monitor none -no-reboot -append 'console=ttyS0 panic=-1 rdinit=/init'
result: PASS: userspace battery (19 recorded output keys spanning shell arithmetic, seq, awk, sort, uniq, wc, md5sum, sha256sum, cksum, id, date, hostname, filesystem ops) completed inside the guest; payload byte-identical (same sha256) across compat-run1, compat-run2, and strict-run1. seed: n/a (determinism comes from Hermit virtual time + QEMU fixed icount clock, no seed)
